customers_say: Customers find the water purifier to be the best in the market with a premium appearance and excellent taste. The installation process receives positive feedback, with knowledgeable installation engineers providing support. While the purifier offers excellent water purification, some customers report issues with white particles appearing in the water. Moreover, the TDS control feature receives mixed reviews, with some customers appreciating the ability to adjust output levels, while others report problems with the device stopping working properly. Additionally, opinions on value for money are divided between those who find it worth the cost and those who regret their purchase.

reviews.author: Jay
reviews.title: Good one
reviews.body: Been using this purifier for a couple of weeks now and overall experience is good. Water tastes clean and the purifier looks quite premium in the kitchen. Installation was also smooth. So far, no issues with the product. The adaptive mode was the main reason I went for this one. Water quality in my area keeps changing, so I didn't want RO running unnecessarily all the time. The purifier adjusts according to the incoming water, which is quite convenient. Good product overall. Build quality is genuinely good. It feels sturdy and the finishing is also nice.
